The '''Battle of Krant''' was the first battle of the [[Krantian Civil War]], during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
[[File:Echuu_Rebel.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Echuu Shen-Jon meets Rebel troopers.]]
Early in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], [[Krant]] became a major rendezvous point for [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]]. [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Yittreas]] was installed as the ruler of the [[Planet/Legends|world]]. The [[Ghost Base]] was built in the forests of Krant to organize all those operations, and the native [[Krantian/Legends|Krantians]] started a resistance force. The Imperials established two military camps, [[Camp Sagol|Sagol]] and [[Camp Kaxol|Kaxol]], near the [[City/Legends|cities]] of [[Peche]] and [[Theenes]]. The Empire also established a research facility in the [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Hanoon|Geddes]]. The Empire also discovered the ancient and powerful [[Jedi artifact/Legends|Jedi artifact]] [[Vor'Na'Tu]] and shipped it to the [[Sith temple (Geddes)|Sith Temple]] on Geddes.<ref name="SW:GB" /> Around [[0 ABY/Legends|0.5 ABY]],<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> Bothan spy [[Utric Sandov]] arranged a meeting with Rebel leader [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] to discuss information that could be vital to the Rebel Alliance&mdash;that the Vor'Na'Tu had been discovered. However, Organa's ship, the ''[[Cretacian]]'', was [[Skirmish in the Krant system|intercepted]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and crashed.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==The battle==
===Defense of the two cities===
[[File:Peche_Theenes_rejunited.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The villages of Theenes and Peche joining the Rebel Alliance.]]
{{Quote|I am Echuu Shen-Jon. I sensed a disturbance in the Force.''"<br />"''You're a Jedi Knight?''"<br />"''I have been in hiding since... the Jedi massacre...|Echuu Shen-Jon meets Leia Organa|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
After her crash on Krant, [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] Leia gathered her surviving escort&mdash;eight [[Rebel trooper/Legends|Rebel troopers]] and the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], and headed away from the crash. They were ambushed by a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] from Camp Sagol in a [[Small Village|village]]. The Rebels were rescued by the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Echuu Shen-Jon]], who was hiding there since the [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|Jedi Massacre]]. C-3PO translated for the Krantians, who gave control of the village and its [[R2-D5]] [[Labor droid/Legends|labor droids]] to Leia Organa. The nearby towns of Pech and Theenes were threatened with extermination at the hands of the two Imperial camps, whose forces set out to destroy Rebel operations in the Krantian cities. Organa and Shen-Jon agreed to help the Krantians defend the three bridges that connected the cities against Imperial assaults. The Imperials forces abandoned the attack after the Rebels destroyed one of the camps. Afterward, Peche and Theenes agreed to join the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SW:GB" />

===Capture of Ghost Base===
{{Quote|Gear up, we're moving out.''"<br />"''Moving out, you're highness.|Leia Organa and a Rebel trooper|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
[[File:Ghost_base.jpg|thumb|left|180px|Ghost Base under Imperial control.]]
Moff Yittreas launched a campaign against the Rebel presence on Krant. [[Strike force Alpha]] attacked Ghost Base, under command of Sandov, and managed to capture it. A Rebel [[Scout/Legends|recon]] [[Unidentified Rebel officer (Ghost Base)|officer]] was wounded trying to delay the Strike Force. Many Rebels were killed or captured but some of them, including Sandov, managed to escape to the nearby [[Le'Roche]] island.<ref name="SW:GB" />

Leia Organa and Shen-Jon gathered a small [[Army/Legends|army]]&mdash;eight troopers and 4 Heavy [[Tauntaun Trooper]]s&mdash;and set out to find Ghost Base. The [[Tree/Legends|tree]] cover closely hid the base, making it difficult for them to find it. The strike force discovered the wounded officer, who recounted his story. After moving out, the Rebel strike force freed a group of captured labor droids and recruited additional forces to attack the defenses the Imperials had placed in Ghost Base. The strike force succeeded in eliminating the Imperial presence in Ghost Base. Afterward, Sandov contacted them, and the [[Krantian Leader]] sent two [[Transport Ship (Rebel Alliance)|Transport Ships]] to bring Organa to the base. Sandov informed them that the Imperials had discovered the Vor'Na'Tu.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Congratulations, troops.|Organa after the strike force defeated one of the camps|<ref name="SW:GB" />}}
Echuu Shen-Jon and the Princess resolved to recover the artifact. They and a crew of Rebels took a [[Unidentified GR-75 medium transport (Krant)|transport]] to Geddes. They succeeded in recovering the artifact, but Shen-Jon shattered it and sacrificed his life to allow Organa to escape.<ref name="SW:GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Krant was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] to the [[2001]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''. It appeared during two consecutive Princess Leia campaign missions. The missions and thus the battle were also included in the game's [[2002]] expansion pack, [[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Clone Campaigns|''Clone Campaigns'']].

The player has the option of destroying either Sagol or Kaxol, and as the choice is a matter of game mechanics, this article is neutral to that choice. The strategy guide suggests attacking Kaxol, the closer camp to the two cities. In both missions, the player has access to workers and can build any sized base and army.
